Name: CropSeason
Author: Suzuran12414
Description: This mod lets crops grow and be harvested across different seasons by adjusting their season list, avoiding untimely withering and frustration. The full code is available on my GitHub: [i][b]https://github.com/ngmeng-lab/CropSeason[/b][/i]

Manifest.Name: CropSeason
Manifest.Description: Able to prevent crops from withering out of season, and allow crops to be planted in seasons they normally can't be grown in.
Manifest.Author: Suzuran_ss
